description: This file defines an abstract exception class 'AbstractPlatformDomainRuleException' for domain rule violations within the Fineract project. It extends from 'AbstractPlatformException' and serves as a base class for domain-specific exceptions indicating rule violations.

classes.name: AbstractPlatformDomainRuleException
classes.description: An abstract class representing exceptions caused by domain rule violations, extending from 'AbstractPlatformException'.

methods.name: AbstractPlatformDomainRuleException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a globalisation message code, default user message, and optional arguments, passing them to the superclass constructor.
